notes: The programme has no dedicated page among the supplied texts; all facts are taken from institution-wide pages. Teaching language is not stated on the supplied pages, so teachingLanguages is omitted. The 30 July application deadline is given for the new Mechanical Engineering BSc programme as well as generally, and the page does not specify it for non-EU/foreign-diploma applicants; the application guideline asks applicants to 'be prepared to discuss your motivation and your English language skills', which implies English but is phrased softly, so no language_proficiency rule is asserted.

note.fr: Un entretien en ligne est organisé et peut porter sur votre motivation et votre niveau d'anglais ; certains programmes peuvent aussi inclure un test de mathématiques.
note.en: An online interview will be held and may cover your motivation and English skills; some programs may also include a mathematics test.

evidence.quote: If your application meets the initial requirements, you will be invited for an online interview.
Be prepared to discuss your motivation and your English language skills.
Some programs may also include a test, often focusing on high school-level mathematics.

note.fr: Des frais de dossier de 200 EUR sont exigibles ; ils sont à payer avec les frais de la première année et ne sont pas remboursables.
note.en: An application fee of EUR 200 is payable; it is to be paid together with the first year's fees and is non-refundable.

evidence.quote: you will need to pay the first year's tuition fee and other applicable fees (e.g., application fee of EUR 200, and dormitory fee of EUR 750)
